final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT translink, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior GROUP BY translink), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgc FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.translink, s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avgc AS diff FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.avgc IS NOT NULL AND s1.cnt > s2.avgc) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(diff) AS avg_excess FROM s3
